タイトル: Part 107: How far below a cloud?
問題2行目: How far *below* a cloud must you stay?
解説: 14 CFR 107.51(d) requires at least 500 feet below the cloud and 2,000 feet horizontally from the cloud.

タイトル: Part 107: Which crash must you report?
問題2行目: Report to the FAA above what cost?
解説: Report within 10 calendar days if property other than the drone has repair cost (or total-loss value) over $500 (14 CFR 107.9).

タイトル: Part 107: Max altitude near a tower
問題2行目: Within 400 ft of a 600-ft tower, how high?
ひっかけ: Trap: It's 400 ft above the *tower's top*!
解説: Within a 400-foot radius of a structure you may fly up to 400 feet above its uppermost limit (14 CFR 107.51(b)).
